picks.headline: Take-a-Break's Fiction Feast tells contributors AI tools will be used on in-house stories
picks.excerpt: Take-a-Break's Fiction Feast magazine has told its regular contributors that 'AI tools will be used' on upcoming in-house stories, a notable shift in editorial practice for one of the UK's best-known short-fiction titles.
picks.rationale: Concrete, first-of-its-kind editorial-practice shift at a well-known UK short-fiction title — actionable for writers/editors and distinct from all published books cards.

picks.headline: Bolinda builds AI clone of Barbara Cartland's voice using interviews, research and human input
picks.excerpt: Audiobook publisher Bolinda used interviews, archival research and human input to build an AI clone of the late romance novelist Barbara Cartland's voice, using it to narrate her catalogue and revive a distinctive authorial voice for new audiobook editions.
picks.rationale: Novel human-in-the-loop AI voice-cloning of a late author for audiobooks — a fresh, credible case study in reviving authorial voice, with real rights/ethics implications for publishing.
